summary: AMC Entertainment Holdings via its subsidiary Muvico issued shares of Class A common stock to exchanging noteholders to settle remaining Senior Secured Exchangeable Notes due 2030. 12,421,152 shares were issued for $13,620,719 principal, representing a mandatory exchange under indenture terms. No board recommendation or advisor named. This is a routine debt-to-equity conversion pursuant to existing note terms, not a new special situation. There is no external catalyst or risk-arb angle; the filing reports only the final cancellation of the notes after a voluntary exchange.
